basics.name: Seth Brasile
basics.label: Engineer · IT/Security · Builder
basics.summary: I am an engineer who also spent the better part of a decade running enterprise IT and security, which means I build software and I have also been the person on the wrong end of the on-call line at 2am. Twelve-plus years across full-stack development, DevOps, and regulated-industry IT — casinos, healthcare, manufacturing, government. I codify, version, review, and secure the things most shops do by hand.

work.name: BetterLife
work.position: Senior Full-Stack Engineer · DevOps · Software Systems Architect
work.summary: Founding engineer and architect for a small-groups ("pods") matchmaking platform — no off-the-shelf solution existed at the time. Built v1 from zero; led the v2 migration to cloud-native SaaS when the market caught up and the business pivoted. Q&A advisory since ~mid-2024.
highlights: Designed and owned the entire v1 platform — frontend, backend, ML, databases, CI/CD.
Hired and led a team of 6: 2 frontend devs, 1 backend dev, 1 senior frontend + UI/UX designer, 1 ML engineer.
Built an R-based ML matchmaking system pairing users with pods that fit.
Built the entire auth stack on Auth0 (Okta) — production SSO, MFA, full user lifecycle.
Led the v2 migration to a cloud-native SaaS stack, deprecating most of the custom dev we had built — the right call once competitive tooling existed and the business pivoted to 1:1 coaching.

work.name: DKBinnovative
work.summary: Designed and built cybersecurity + compliance automation across enterprise Windows/Linux/Mac fleets (2,500–3,200 endpoints) in healthcare and manufacturing.
highlights: Daily PowerShell development for workstation and service-management tooling; built Go tools to orchestrate it and aggregate reporting data.
Built a proof-of-concept MSP code-delivery + RMM platform in Go — cross-platform agent + server-side broker over gRPC + mutual TLS.
Led PrintNightmare response across the client base — PowerShell/GPO mitigations, then eliminated traditional print servers entirely via centralized print management.
Migrated all delivered PowerShell to a GitHub source-of-truth model — scripts execute in-memory from raw URLs, removing the local-file tampering surface and forcing PR review.
Compliance remediation against HIPAA / NIST / CMMC-adjacent scans supplied by a formal security team.
Automated distributed enterprise Windows update/upgrade management; owned internal tooling and infrastructure.
